resources.string: With your garden, from seed to harvest.
AVORA brings plant growth, irrigation, and fertilization into one place. Sensor readings, photos, and care history help you make informed decisions about everyday garden care.
Keep photos, observations, and milestones organized by season. Open manual irrigation and fertilization from the + menu.
Assess plant photos alongside garden data. Follow seedling batches from sowing through transfer to a growing season.
Monitor soil moisture and manage manual and automatic irrigation. Review completed watering sessions and their results.
Track fertilizer recommendations, product stock, and application schedules. Record the treatments you apply and their results.
Sync data with your NAS and manage data and photo backups. Control account and device access in Settings.
System versions reflect the latest information reported by each device.
Explore the source code and follow the project on GitHub.
Open the AVORA project on GitHub
